alerts.title: Sue Bierman Park Renovation | Notice of Tree Removals
alerts.body: Tree removals will begin on or after September 14, 2026. Once tree work begins, it is expected to last five weeks. Sections of the park and connected pathways will be closed intermittently.

alerts.title: Portsmouth Square is closed for renovation through mid-2028
alerts.body: The park, located above the Portsmouth Square parking garage, will receive a complete renovation.

alerts.title: India Basin Shoreline Park | In Construction
alerts.body: The proposed plans for IBSP include major site regrading to ease steep slopes to allow for more site access and create additional opportunities for shoreline habitat. The concept plans would maintain and expand the current active recreational amenities and increases opportunities to gather, recreate and play.
